pageSummary: Connect PalmPay with your merchant credentials and RSA keys.
ipAllowlistDescription: Required for live. Add every address below in PalmPay.
reviewConfirmation: I've whitelisted these Capisum IPs in PalmPay live
rsaCopyPublicCommand: openssl rsa -pubin -in public.pem -outform DER | base64 | pbcopy
rsaCopyPrivateCommand: openssl pkcs8 -topk8 -inform PEM -outform DER -nocrypt -in private.pem | base64 | pbcopy
